issue.title: Ctrl+Shift+P refresh value stage passes a string footer hint, so renderFooter throws before results render

task_type_fields.impact: The Ctrl+Shift+P "Refresh every" row (the documented "see it less often" review outcome in docs/freshness.md) likely cannot be used: the value stage paints stale rows and a blind ↵ can write a 2-day refresh the user never saw. Fix: pass `[{ keys: ["↵"], label: "Apply" }, { keys: ["esc"], label: "Dismiss" }]` (Esc closes the picker; it does not go back) and harden renderFooter to skip or stringify non-object hints; add a DOM-stub test that opens the stage through renderAll.
task_type_fields.repro: By code reading (bob-plugins master 79d5975): BulletPropertyPickerModal.showRefreshValueStage (plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/main.js:24955) passes `footerHints: ["↵ apply · esc back"]` — a bare string — where every other stage passes `{ keys: [...], label }` objects. FilteredPickerModal.renderFooter (main.js:~16068) does `hint.keys.forEach(...)` for each hint, so a string hint throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'forEach')`. renderAll() calls renderFooter() BEFORE renderResults(), so in a real (DOM-backed) modal: Ctrl+Shift+P → "Refresh every" row → ↵ should throw, leaving the stage-one property rows painted while applyOptions() has already pointed this.items/visibleItems at the refresh presets. A following ↵ would then apply the first preset (2 days) that is not on screen. Minimal logic check: `node -e 'const hints=["↵ apply · esc back"]; hints.forEach((h)=>h.keys.forEach(()=>{}))'` throws. The class is not exported and the node tests never open a DOM-backed modal (resultsEl is null, so renderAll is skipped), which is why scripts/test-navigation-stamps.cjs does not catch it. Corroborating signal: the Bob vault contains zero `[refresh:: N]` fields although the row shipped in nav 1.44.0. Confirm in Obsidian before fixing.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching the Ctrl+Shift+P panel redesign: the refresh stage's footer hint has the wrong shape, which likely breaks the Refresh every row in real Obsidian and may explain why the vault has zero refresh fields.

evidence.note: Independent code read (bob-plugins master 79d5975, nav 1.71.0): confirmed showRefreshValueStage (main.js:24971) passes footerHints: ["↵ apply · esc back"] (a string) and FilteredPickerModal.renderFooter calls hint.keys.forEach. Wider impact than the original report: the approved-decay card's Less-often picker path (openFreshnessDecayLessOftenPicker, main.js ~35303-35394, used when lessOften.mode === "picker", i.e. 90+ day intervals) calls picker.showRefreshValueStage(...), overrides items/title/getSubtitle/openItem but NOT footerHints, then picker.open(); onOpen -> renderAll -> renderFooter throws, so the surrounding catch shows 'Could not update task; no tasks were updated' and the preset list never renders. Timing: docs/freshness.md (review outcomes) documents 'see it less often (Ctrl+Shift+P -> refresh -> 14 / 30 / 90)' for the trial that starts 2026-10-05, and the decision card activates 2026-10-19, so the fix should land before 10-05. Vault re-check: still 0 [refresh:: N] fields.
